झ: झ jh The aspirate of the preceding.
झ (झः) 1. m. Vrihashpati; chief of the demon's; sound. f. (झा) A water-fall. a. Asleep; lost.
झञ्झा: झञ्झा (ञ्झा) 1. f. Wind, a hurricane; a clanging; heavy rain; thing lost.
झट्: झट् झटति 1. a. To clot (as hair).
झटि: झटि (टिः) 2. m. A small tree, a shrub.
झर: झर (रः) 1. m. A cascade. (रा-रिः-री) Idem. (री) f. A river.
झर्च्: झर्च् (श) झर्चति 6. a. To say, to blame.
झर्झ्: झर्झ् (कि) झर्झति, झर्झयति 1. 10. a. To speak or say, to reprove. झर्झति 1. a. To hurt or kill.
झर्झर: झर्झर (रः) 1. m. The Kali yug. The name of a river. (रः-री) m. f. A kind of drum. f. (रा) A whore. n. Sound of splashing.
झर्झरीक: झर्झरीक (कः) 1. m. The body; a country; a picture.
झलञ्झला: झलञ्झला (ला) 1. f. The flapping of an elephant's ears, &c.
झलरी: झलरी (री) 3. f. A drum; a curl.
झला: झला (ला) 1. f. A daughter; sun-shine, splendour; a cricket.
झल्ल: झल्ल (ल्लः) 1. m. A prize-fighter; a cudgel player; degraded man.
झल्लरी: झल्लरी (री) 3. f. A drum; a curl; a ball of perfume; moisture.
झल्लिका: झल्लिका (का) 1. f. Light, splendour; a rag for applying perfumes, or the dirt rubbed off by it.
झल्लोल: झल्लोल (लः) 1. m. A ball or protu-berance at the end of a spindle.
झष्: झष् झषति 1. a. To hurt, kill, or to take; to put on, to wear.
झष: झष (षः) 1. m. A fish; the sign Pis-ces; heat; a forest. f. A plant (Hedysarum lagopodeoides).
झषाङ्क: झषा_ङ्क (ङ्कः) 1. m. A name of Ani-ruddha the son of Kāma.
झषोदरी: झषो_दरी (री) 3. f. A proper name, the mother of the poet Vyāsa.
झाङ्कृत: झाङ्कृत (तं) 1. n. A tinkling orna-ment worn on the toes or feet.
झाट: झाट (टः) 1. m. An arbour; a wood; cleansing sores. f. (टा-टी) A plant, Flacourtia. n. A wood.
झामर: झामर (रः) 1. m. A small whetstone for spindles, needles, &c.
झार्झर: झार्झर (रः-रा) 1. m. f. A cymbal player.
झालि: झालि (लिः) 2. f. Unripe mangoes fried with salt, mustard, &c.
झिङ्गिनी: झिङ्गिनी (नी) 3. f. A torch, a fire-brand; a cucumber.
झिञ्जिम: झिञ्जिम (मः) 1. m. A forest on fire.
झिल्लिका: झिल्लिका (का) 1. f. A cricket; its cry; splendour; a rag for rubbing perfumes or the dirt rubbed off.
झुण्ट: झुण्ट (ण्टः) 1. m. A shrub, a bush.
झूणि: झूणि (णिः) 2. f. A kind of betel-nut; warning voice from heaven.
झूमेरि: झूमेरि (रिः) 2. f. One of the Rāginīs.
झॄ: झॄ झीर्य्यति 1. a. (ग, ष) झॄणाति 9. a. To grow old.
